evidence_records.evidence_context: Advanced melanoma, not postoperative adjuvant therapy
evidence_records.trial_population: Previously untreated BRAF V 600-mutant metastatic melanoma
evidence_records.intervention: Dabrafenib 150 mg twice daily + trametinib 2 mg daily
key_findings: Preplanned interim 12-month OS:72% versus 65%; HR 0.69 (95% CI 0.53–0.89), P=.005.
Median PFS 11.4 versus 7.3 months; HR 0.56 (95% CI 0.46–0.69).
evidence_records.limitations: Stopped early at the prespecified efficacy boundary. This compares with vemurafenib alone, not modern immunotherapy or another BRAF/MEK combination; it does not predict an individual outcome.
evidence_records.match_type: Direct dose match; source-defined eligibility still governs treatment
evidence_records.review_status: Primary publication checked; independent clinical/pharmacy review pending

evidence_records.trial_population: BRAF V 600 E/K unresectable stageIIIC orIV melanoma
evidence_records.intervention: Dabrafenib 150 mg twice daily + trametinib 2 mg daily
evidence_records.primary_endpoint: Primary PFS; this report gives secondary OS
key_findings: January 2015 cutoff: median OS 25.1 versus 18.7 months; HR 0.71 (95% CI 0.55–0.92), P=.0107.
Updated median PFS 11.0 versus 8.8 months; HR 0.67 (95% CI 0.53–0.84).
Grade 3/4 adverse events 32% versus 31%; pyrexia was common with the combination.
evidence_records.limitations: Do not confuse updated PFS 11.0 months with the earlier 2014 analysis 9.3 months. Comparator is dabrafenib monotherapy, not immunotherapy; PFS P-value in this update was not multiplicity-adjusted.
evidence_records.match_type: Direct dose match; source-defined eligibility still governs treatment
evidence_records.review_status: Primary publication checked; independent clinical/pharmacy review pending

evidence_records.study_design: Pooled extended follow-up of combination arms; n=563
evidence_records.trial_population: Previously untreated BRAF V 600 E/K unresectable/metastatic melanoma
evidence_records.intervention: Dabrafenib 150 mg twice daily + trametinib 2 mg daily
evidence_records.comparator: No pooled concurrent comparator estimate in this report
evidence_records.primary_endpoint: Five-year PFS and OS follow-up; original trials had different primary endpoints
key_findings: Five-year PFS 19% (95% CI 15–22).
Five-year OS 34% (95% CI 30–38).
evidence_records.limitations: Descriptive pooled treated-arm outcomes are not a five-year randomised treatment effect, individual prediction or adjuvant recurrence estimate. Prognostic factors and subsequent treatments affect survival.

evidence_records.study_design: Randomised double-blind placebo-controlled phase III; n=870
evidence_records.trial_population: AJCC 7 stageIIIA with nodal deposits>1 mm, IIIB orIIIC; BRAF V 600 E/K; ECOG 0–1
evidence_records.intervention: Dabrafenib 150 mg twice daily + trametinib 2 mg daily for 12 months
key_findings: At median 2.8 years follow-up,3-year RFS 58% versus 39%; HR 0.47 (95% CI 0.39–0.58).
The early OS difference did not cross its stringent prespecified interim significance boundary.
evidence_records.limitations: Historical staging and nodal selection matter. Not evidence for stageII, unresected disease or neoadjuvant treatment. Do not use the early OS signal instead of the final 2024 analysis.
evidence_records.match_type: Direct dose match; source-defined eligibility still governs treatment
evidence_records.review_status: Primary publication checked; independent clinical/pharmacy review pending

evidence_records.trial_population: Resected BRAF V 600 E/K stageIII melanoma
key_findings: Five-year RFS 52% versus 36%; HR 0.51 (95% CI 0.42–0.61).
Five-year distant-metastasis-free survival 65% versus 54%; HR 0.55 (95% CI 0.44–0.70).
evidence_records.limitations: These percentages describe being alive without relapse or distant metastasis, not overall survival or cure. Retain the endpoint and five-year timepoint explicitly.
evidence_records.match_type: Direct dose match; source-defined eligibility still governs treatment
evidence_records.review_status: Primary publication checked; independent clinical/pharmacy review pending

evidence_records.study_design: Final follow-up of randomised placebo-controlled trial; n=870
evidence_records.intervention: Dabrafenib 150 mg twice daily + trametinib 2 mg daily for 12 months
evidence_records.primary_endpoint: Final OS plus RFS and distant-metastasis-free survival
key_findings: Median follow-up 8.33 years versus 6.87 years.
OS HR 0.80 (95% CI 0.62–1.01), P=.06: overall-population survival improvement was NOT statistically significant.
RFS HR 0.52 (95% CI 0.43–0.63); distant-metastasis-free survival HR 0.56 (95% CI 0.44–0.71).
evidence_records.limitations: Do not claim proven overall survival benefit for the overall trial population. A favourable V 600 E subgroup does not replace the nonsignificant overall analysis. Postoperative results must not be applied to advanced disease.
evidence_records.match_type: Direct dose match; source-defined eligibility still governs treatment
evidence_records.review_status: Primary publication checked; independent clinical/pharmacy review pending

evidence_records.trial_population: BRAF V 600 E/K, ECOG 0–1; untreated or progressed after first-line immunotherapy
evidence_records.intervention: Encorafenib 450 mg daily + binimetinib 45 mg twice daily
evidence_records.comparator: Vemurafenib 960 mg twice daily; third arm encorafenib 300 mg daily
evidence_records.primary_endpoint: Blinded independent central-review PFS: combination versus vemurafenib
key_findings: Median 16.6 months follow-up: median PFS 14.9 versus 7.3 months; HR 0.54 (95% CI 0.41–0.71).
evidence_records.limitations: Use this original PFS HR with its original analysis, not a later updated HR. Encorafenib dose differs between combination and monotherapy arms. Not adjuvant evidence or a comparison with immunotherapy.
evidence_records.match_type: Direct dose match; source-defined eligibility still governs treatment
evidence_records.review_status: Primary publication checked; independent clinical/pharmacy review pending

evidence_records.study_design: Secondary OS analysis of randomised phase III
evidence_records.intervention: Encorafenib 450 mg daily + binimetinib 45 mg twice daily
evidence_records.comparator: Vemurafenib 960 mg twice daily; encorafenib 300 mg third arm
evidence_records.primary_endpoint: OS is secondary to the original PFS primary endpoint
key_findings: Median OS follow-up 36.8 months: median OS 33.6 versus 16.9 months; HR 0.61 (95% CI 0.47–0.79), versus vemurafenib.
Combination Grade 3/4 GGT elevation 9%, CK elevation 7%, hypertension 6%; one death considered possibly treatment-related.
evidence_records.limitations: The median difference is not a promise of extra survival for one person. Do not transfer this comparison to a different combination or pair it with updated follow-up statistics.
evidence_records.match_type: Direct dose match; source-defined eligibility still governs treatment
evidence_records.review_status: Primary publication checked; independent clinical/pharmacy review pending

evidence_records.study_design: Post hoc descriptive five-year analysis of randomised part 1
evidence_records.intervention: Encorafenib 450 mg daily + binimetinib 45 mg twice daily
evidence_records.comparator: Vemurafenib 960 mg twice daily; encorafenib 300 mg daily
evidence_records.primary_endpoint: Long-term PFS/OS update; original primary endpoint was PFS
key_findings: Five-year PFS 23% with combination versus 10% with vemurafenib.
Five-year OS 35% versus 21%; encorafenib-alone five-year OS was also 35%.
Updated OS HR versus vemurafenib 0.64 (95% CI 0.50–0.81); versus encorafenib 0.93 (95% CI 0.72–1.19).
evidence_records.limitations: Post hoc descriptive update; trial not powered for OS comparisons. Few patients had brain metastases. No proven OS superiority over encorafenib alone and no head-to-head conclusion against dabrafenib/trametinib or immunotherapy.
evidence_records.match_type: Direct dose match; source-defined eligibility still governs treatment
evidence_records.review_status: Primary publication checked; independent clinical/pharmacy review pending
